s1.p1: BTS — Bizarro Total Solutions ("we", "our company") provides home technical services (electrical, telecommunications, carpentry and others). This platform allows clients to request services and track their status.

s2.intro: We only collect the data necessary to provide the service:
lista: Identification data: name, email and phone number.
Address data, when needed to send a technician.
Service request details: description, photos/attachments, comments and history.

s3.titulo: 3. What we use the data for
lista: Managing your account and authentication on the platform.
Processing and tracking your service requests.
Communicating with you about scheduling, quotes and invoices.
Complying with legal and tax obligations.

s4.p1: We process your data based on the performance of the service contract between you and BTS, your consent (where applicable) and compliance with legal obligations, under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

s5.p1: We don't sell or share your data with third parties for marketing purposes. Your data is stored on trusted third-party infrastructure (database and hosting providers) acting as processors, solely for the technical operation of the platform.

s6.titulo: 6. How long we keep your data
s6.p1: We keep your data while your account is active and for the additional period required by legal and tax obligations. You can request deletion of your account at any time through the contacts below.

s7.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the right to:
lista: Access the data we hold about you.
Request erasure of your data ("right to be forgotten").
Object to processing or request its restriction.
s7.contacta: To exercise any of these rights, contact us by email

s8.p1: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including role-based access control and encryption in communications.

s9.p1: We only use cookies that are strictly necessary for the platform to work — specifically, a session cookie that keeps your account signed in while you browse. Without this cookie, you cannot stay signed in.
s9.p2: We don't use advertising cookies, third-party tracking, or analytics tools that identify your browsing. Since these cookies are essential to the service, they can't be disabled while keeping access to your account — but they are never used for anything other than keeping you securely signed in.

s10.p1: We may update this policy periodically. The last update date is shown at the top of this page.

s11.p1: For questions about privacy and data protection, contact us at {email} or {telefone}.
